prescriptions.remedy_label_human: Recite the Moon beej mantra 'Om Shraam Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namah' 108 times daily on Monday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Recite the Mars beej mantra 'Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namah' 108 times daily on Tuesday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Recite the Ketu beej mantra 'Om Sraam Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namah' 108 times daily on Saturday/Tuesday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Recite the Rahu beej mantra 'Om Bhraam Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namah' 108 times daily on Saturday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Recite the Jupiter beej mantra 'Om Graam Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namah' 108 times daily on Thursday, facing east. Complete mahadasha-count japa over the dasha period.
Chant Guru Ashtottara Shatanamavali 108 times on Thursdays. Jupiter (Guru) blesses with wisdom, wealth, and progeny when propitiated.

For Saturn-ruled chronic disease (bones, joints, nervous system; Saturn in 6H/8H or Sade Sati with health impact): perform Mahamrityunjaya japa to the prescribed count — 1,25,000 (1.25 lakh) for a ful
For afflicted Jupiter (debilitated in Capricorn, Guru Chandal dosha, retrograde in dasha): recite Vishnu Sahasranama (Mahabharata, Anushasana Parva 149) once daily on Thursdays. Jupiter is the karaka
prescriptions.classical_citation: Phaladeepika remedial section; Mahabharata Anushasana Parva 149

prescriptions.classical_citation: Valmiki Ramayana, Yuddha Kanda 107; BPHS Ch.88 (Surya upaya)
